The new HMPV Virus Symptoms & Prevention for safety
🦠 A new virus, Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV), is making headlines. Here's what you need to know about its symptoms, as per WHO, and how to stay safe. 👇 #HMPV #Health

nodes.author: Rajeshwari224
nodes.text:
Symptoms of HMPV:
HMPV primarily causes respiratory illnesses. Watch out for:
Fever 🤒

Coughing 😷
Shortness of breath 🫁
Nasal congestion 🤧
Sore throat 🔥
In severe cases, it can lead to pneumonia or bronchiolitis, especially in children & the elderly.

nodes.author: Rajeshwari224
nodes.text:
Prevention Measures:
WHO recommends these steps to protect yourself:
✅ Regular handwashing with soap 🧼
✅ Use a mask in crowded spaces 😷
✅ Avoid close contact with sick individuals 🚷
✅ Cover your mouth when sneezing/coughing 🤲
✅ Keep surfaces clean 🧽

nodes.author: Rajeshwari224
nodes.text:
The virus can affect anyone but is particularly risky for:

Young children 👶
Elderly individuals 👵
Immunocompromised patients 💉

nodes.author: Rajeshwari224
nodes.text: While there’s no specific treatment for HMPV, supportive care like hydration, rest, and fever control can help. If symptoms worsen, consult a healthcare provider immediately! 🚑

nodes.author: Rajeshwari224
nodes.text:
Staying informed is key. Follow credible sources like WHO for updates. Together, we can tackle HMPV. 🌍

#StaySafe #PublicHealth #healthisrealwealth
